common_assumptions: Git branch and working tree are in expected state before operations
External services and test infrastructure are available without verification
File paths and directory structures match prior knowledge from earlier in the chain
Previously read file contents remain current across long multi-step chains
strength_patterns: Multi-source cross-referencing (PR view, diff, comments, commits) before committing to decisions
Iterative test-and-verify loops catch regressions before pushing to remotes
Explicit state inspection (git status, pr view, lsof) before destructive or hard-to-reverse steps
weakness_patterns: Repeated reads of the same file without intervening changes indicate stalled or looping reasoning
Long chains accumulate context drift causing late-chain tool calls to re-verify early findings redundantly
Alternatives are rarely explored; first viable path is pursued linearly with low branching breadth
